@graph.name: Turn a WhatsApp chat into a PDF
@graph.description: To save a WhatsApp chat as a PDF, export it in WhatsApp (Export chat), drop the ZIP or .txt here and download the PDF. It reads like the chat: each message in a bubble with its name and time, your own on the right, the day between them, photos and stickers in place, and voice notes, videos and documents listed by name. The chat is read in your browser, so it never leaves your device.

step.name: Export the chat in WhatsApp
step.text: On an iPhone, open the chat, tap the person's or group's name at the top, then Export Chat, and choose Attach Media to have the photos. On Android, open the chat and tap ⋮ (More options), More, Export chat, then Include media. Save what WhatsApp makes to your phone or computer.

step.name: Drop the export on the page
step.text: Drop the ZIP on tuul.io/whatsapp-chat-to-pdf/, or the .txt together with its photos and voice notes when Android shared them one by one. The chat is read on your device; nothing is uploaded.

step.name: Choose your side and the days
step.text: Pick whose messages go on the right (the tool guesses it when the export gives it away), the first and last day to include, A4 or Letter, and whether photos and stickers are drawn in the chat or only listed by name.

step.name: Download the PDF
step.text: The PDF opens with the chat's name, the people in it, the days it covers and how many messages it holds. A very long chat with thousands of photos comes as several PDFs by date, so the browser never has to hold too much at once.

mainEntity.name: How do I convert a WhatsApp chat to PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Export the chat in WhatsApp first: Export Chat on an iPhone (tap the chat's name at the top), or ⋮ > More > Export chat on Android. Then drop the ZIP or .txt it makes on tuul.io/whatsapp-chat-to-pdf/ and download the PDF. Messages come out as bubbles with names and times, with the photos in place, and nothing is uploaded.

mainEntity.name: How do I export a WhatsApp chat on an iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open the chat, tap the person's or group's name at the top, scroll down and tap Export Chat. Choose Attach Media to include photos, or Without Media for a smaller file, then Save to Files. The result is a ZIP named like "WhatsApp Chat - Ana.zip": drop it on tuul.io/whatsapp-chat-to-pdf/ as it is, without unzipping it.

mainEntity.name: How do I export a WhatsApp chat on Android?

acceptedAnswer.text: Open the chat, tap ⋮ (More options), More, then Export chat, and choose Include media or Without media. Pick where to send it, such as Google Drive, Files or an email to yourself. Android often shares a .txt plus each photo and voice note as separate files: drop them all together on tuul.io/whatsapp-chat-to-pdf/.

mainEntity.name: Does the PDF include the photos?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, when the chat was exported with media (Attach Media on iPhone, Include media on Android): photos and stickers appear in their bubbles, and videos, voice messages and documents are listed by name with their length or size. An export made without media only names them; the PDF says which ones weren't in the export.

mainEntity.name: Which messages go on the right?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yours, as on your phone. An export doesn't say who made it, so tuul.io/whatsapp-chat-to-pdf/ works it out where it can (in a chat named after the other person, or from your "You deleted this message") and lets you pick anyone, or no one, under On the right.

mainEntity.name: Is my chat uploaded anywhere?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The export is read and the PDF is made by your browser, on your phone or computer. The chat, its photos and the PDF never leave your device, which matters for private conversations.

mainEntity.name: Can it handle a very long chat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A chat of 100,000 messages becomes one PDF in your browser. With thousands of photos the PDF would be too big for a browser to hold, so it comes as several PDFs by date, each one complete. You can also pick a range of days, or list photos by name for one smaller PDF. WhatsApp's own export may leave out the oldest messages of a very long chat.

mainEntity.name: How do I print a WhatsApp chat?

acceptedAnswer.text: Make the PDF on tuul.io/whatsapp-chat-to-pdf/, open it and print it from your PDF viewer. Choose A4 or Letter before you make it so the pages fit your paper.

mainEntity.name: Is this an official WhatsApp tool?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. tuul.io isn't made by or connected to WhatsApp or Meta. It reads the file WhatsApp's own Export chat makes, which is yours to keep and share.
